company: First Light | Amber Enterprises, Ashok Leyland, WPI
headline: First Light | Amber Enterprises, Ashok Leyland, WPI

highlights: Margin fell 180bps YoY to 3.7%, as gross margin contracted 170bps.
On the company’s definition, which excludes ESOP cost and non-operating items, operating EBITDA grew 30% YoY to Rs 1.3bn.
Cost inflation pushes CD EBITDA into loss: CD revenue rose 43% YoY to Rs 12.5bn.
CD posted an EBITDA loss of Rs 139mn, against a Rs 335mn profit in Q2FY26.
valuation: Food inflation remains a major driver, with, food grains (both cereals and pulses), vegetables, fruits, milk, eggs and meat product all exhibiting upside pressures.
We lower our multiple to 38x from 40x and assign it to Sep’28E EPS.
Input PPI has also begun showing upside pressure (MoM) in 11 of the 21 manufactured product indices (electronics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, textiles, machinery, textiles etc).
watch: The cuts factor in lower CD and Railway margin guidance and a lower Railway growth outlook.
